text.en: Embodied agents need many houses to learn from. We generate them from rules.
Hand-built scenes are few and slow to make, e.g. a dozen per month.
A validator checks every house: a breadth-first search on a 0.25 m grid must reach at least 5 positions in each room.
text.es: Un validador revisa cada casa: una búsqueda en anchura sobre una retícula de 0.25 m debe alcanzar al menos 5 posiciones en cada cuarto.

text.en: Figure 1: The generation stages, from outline to objects.
A house that fails is sampled again from the same room spec. Agents trained this way reach 31.4% more goals.
[1] M. Deitke et al. ProcTHOR. NeurIPS 2022.
